description: Nomid staff only (Nomid system admins; refused for everyone else). Lists the workflows of one company: the automatic rules Nomid runs on every status report of its Android Management devices. Use company to name the company; another customer's needs an "All Nomid customers" connection. Each has its uuid, name, enabled, createdAt, trigger (types; conditions on policyPathName, policyPathNameChangingTo, status or pathName, all of which must match) and action: actionKeys and params. Actions: force-password-on-enrollment sets params.password as the screen lock of a device right after it enrolls (within params.secondsAfterEnrollment, default 300); changed-to-policy sets it when a device moves from a policy whose path name contains params.previousPolicyPathNameContains to one containing params.currentPolicyPathNameContains; sim-changed tags a device sim-changed or sim-removed. Passwords are never shown: passwordLength says how long a text one is (Android 14 and later need 6 or more), and passwordIsText false means the actions skip it. unknownActionKeys lists keys no action answers to: those are skipped, and a workflow with no other key does nothing. To see whether a workflow ran on a device, look at the device (list_device_commands for the password it set). It changes nothing.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

name: read_workflows
title: Read a company's workflows (Nomid staff)
